integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof and separately implemented enumeration programs included. Finite checks are not infinite proofs. No absolute historical priority or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only initially fixed and least-period-two states are counted. The exponential lower bound applies to lengths divisible by five; no full-sequence entropy constant or basin census is asserted. Some relevant older source full text was inaccessible.
